They run escorted and tailor-made Swiss rail tours on Swiss Travel Passes, the Glacier and Bernina Express and lake steamers - exactly the rail, hotel and sightseeing ground product STC supplies.

weights_rationale: Hybrid pipeline: deterministic Switzerland/Europe + source-market scoring over the 14k-row pool, then per-operator web research and adversarial fit verification. Final 10 hand-curated for balance across operator types (rail/scenic, alpine walking, escorted-Europe volume, luxury FIT, ski) and the two strongest source markets in scope (UK, US).
prospect_summary: Switzerland Travel Centre is the official and largest inbound tour operator for Switzerland, supplying 2,000+ Swiss hotels, rail product (Swiss Travel Pass, scenic trains) and custom round trips to international tour operators. Good partners are outbound operators in source markets that sell Switzerland or multi-country Europe and need a Swiss ground partner.
